== Hero Usage ==
* Heroes only use this skill while moving. They ''will'' cancel it with other skills.

== Notes ==
*[[Melee attack]] skills will cancel the stance before it would apply bonus damage.
* If attacking multiple enemies using a scythe, only one enemy (which will not be the target) takes the bonus damage from this skill.
